toolDefinitions.name: body_stop
toolDefinitions.description: Cancel this turn’s motion and wait for feedback. Inspect fault and stop acknowledgement; requesting stop does not establish physical rest. No further motion is admitted in this turn.

toolDefinitions.name: clear_motion_fault
toolDefinitions.description: Clear the console software motion-fault latch after the operator explicitly requests recovery and confirms the robot has stopped and the situation has been inspected. First read ego_state and use its current fault_id. Never invent operator confirmation or clear automatically after failure. No hardware reset, homing, movement, or retry is performed; previous failure evidence remains. Rejects active operations and stale fault IDs. Does not undo body_stop or enable motion; after stopping this turn, wait for a new operator turn before motion. A cleared latch does not prove hardware health or establish a lift origin.

fault_id.description: Exact current fault_id from ego_state; never guess or reuse an older fault ID.

operator_confirmed_stopped.description: Must be true only when the operator has explicitly confirmed physical rest and inspection for this fault.

reason.description: Operator-provided inspection/recovery reason, 1–1000 characters; not a claim of sensor verification.

toolDefinitions.name: ego_state
toolDefinitions.description: Read cached real-motion state, faults, configured map and fixed speed limits. Does not contact actuators or measure the current pose.

toolDefinitions.name: lift_move
toolDefinitions.description: Move the real lift. action=height sets an absolute integer height in mm (0–750); action=home moves DOWN to the physical limit and establishes zero, and must omit height_mm. Homing is explicit, never automatic. After motor power loss the operator must establish the origin with home before height moves. Fixed 400 RPM. Blocks; require state=succeeded before dependent work.

action.description: height moves to an absolute height; home explicitly moves down to the limit and establishes zero.

toolDefinitions.name: navigate_to_pose
toolDefinitions.description: Move the real chassis to one absolute map pose. x/y are meters; heading_deg is degrees from map +X. Requires the named map already loaded and localized. Fixed 0.1 m/s and 0.1 rad/s, obstacle avoidance enabled. Blocks until success or failure; inspect state before dependent actions. Never retry an uncertain outcome. No object locations or routes are inferred.

x.description: Absolute map X coordinate in meters.

y.description: Absolute map Y coordinate in meters.

map_name.description: Exact name of the currently loaded and localized map.
